shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index decreased 374 points or 0.70 percent on Monday to close at 53186 points.The decline was led by Alphabet (-3.16%), Amazon (-2.45%) and Honeywell International (-1.90%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Chevron (2.33%), Walmart (1.73%) and Salesforce (1.72%).
